description: pnpm 12: the npm package is a launcher, and install.js links the native executable of @pnpm/exe.linux-x64(-musl) over its pnpm bin. That executable is the Rust crate pnpm-cli, bin pnpm, built from the pnpm/pnpm tag v<version>, which the npm provenance attestations of pnpm and of both exe packages name. Upstream's own release build: --release --locked -p pnpm-cli --bin pnpm, no features, after its install-crates step's pnpm install --frozen-lockfile --filter @pnpm/esm-loader, whose prepare script generates the cas-loader.mjs.inc that deps-restorer includes (pnpmInstall; the crates half of that step is the vendor step). The tree pins Rust 1.97.0 and one crate in the graph (tree-sitter-iter) declares rust-version 1.97; the toolchain image carries 1.96.0, on which it compiles, so the build passes --ignore-rust-version until the image moves to 1.97. Versions: pnpm 11 and older are JavaScript with no native executable (no optionalDependencies), so there is nothing to substitute below 12.0.0 (min).
